changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6681-declared-lazy-marketplace-routes.md`

- names `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Both marketplace chunks were held by CHUNK CO-TENANCY, not by any import of the page: rolldown had parked `components/SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx` (statically imported by the eager `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) in the first, and `console/marketplace/InstalledListWidget.tsx` (bare-imported by the package barrel for its SDUI registration) in the second. An `app-shell-eager-leaves` group in `apps/console/vite.config.ts` isolates those co-tenants so the three declared-lazy pages chunk by their own dynamic-only reachability. The console eager closure moves 3180.2 KB → 3171.5 KB gzipped (−8,888 bytes, 48 → 45 eager chunks) with the three per-chunk ceilings unmoved.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `969d4f291` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1860 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2472 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36794846386)

|--------|-------|--------|
| **Eager closure** (gzip, 330 chunks) | **3584.7 KB** | 3607.4 KB |
| Main entry chunk (gzip) | 150.1 KB | 350 KB |
| Entry file | `index-QAuSAUve.js` | — |
| Status | **PASS** | — |

The **eager closure** is every chunk the entry reaches through static imports — what the browser fetches and parses before the app renders. The entry chunk on its own is a small fraction of it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f5af9cb96223fb4f3b076b5ef71c8ced1e7f8d19`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

Inputs: card #11272 (body; triage `5920456880`; claim `5921156111`; dev report `5922037936`), PR #11296 (body, its 3 files, the net diff against `main` from the merge-base `b4333ab8a3`: +425/−55), and the head's check-runs, read three times. Read-only beside them, for the binding this PR extends: PR #11265 (merged `fc650380d7`) and card #11232's comments (triage `5915804318`, claim `5918635427`, dev report `5919488482`, record `5919729760`, ACCEPT `5919754584`). Nothing built, run or re-run.

**Accept sets and public surface: none move.** `useDraftAutoSave` and `DraftSend` stay module-private to `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`; the new `loadedFor: string` option is required, so all four in-file callers pass it or fail `Type Check` (green on the head). `sending` now returns `DraftSend | null`; its only readers are the two in-file explicit saves, and both return on `null` (`toggleEnabled` at `:4513`, `doReorderFields` at `:3574`). `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` exports `StudioDesignSurface` and `StudioDesignSurfaceProps` from this file (`:436`), not the pillars and not the hook; `StudioDesignSurfaceProps` and every pillar's props are unchanged (`key` is React's at the mount site, not a prop). No new i18n key (`engine.studio.loading` and `engine.studio.unpublishedDraft` are reused; `check:i18n-keys` green). Named right.

**(a) One rule, read at source.** The hook's single check `owned()` is now `since === target && loadedFor === target` (`:299`); the timer's send, `flush` and `sending` all go through it, and `loaded` is the same `loadedFor === target` read in render (`:329`). Each caller writes its stamp only where a load installs a buffer: the page inspector at the editable load's install (`:2274`) and in the non-editable branch (`:2245`); the Interfaces nav at the app load's install (`:2134`; the `readOnly` revert at `:1868` re-installs the same app's baseline, so the stamp stays true); Data at its install (`:3356`); Automations at its install (`:4439`). No pillar carries a comparison of its own: every pillar-side read (`draftLoaded`, `objLoaded`, `flowLoaded`, the `addField` guard) is the hook's output, the UI half of one rule. Inside triage's "extend that binding" and its ⛔ on a per-pillar variant. Right.

**(b) The three members and their pins.**
- **Member 1, the load window.** Page inspector: the canvas shows the spinner on `!draftLoaded`, the rail body renders empty, the badge waits. Automations: the enable switch is not rendered on `!flowLoaded` and `toggleEnabled` asks `sending` first; canvas and inspector wait; badge waits. Data: the views show the spinner on `!objLoaded`; add-field is not rendered and `addField` refuses on `!objLoaded`; the reorder asks `sending` first and now mutates the buffer only after a claim (right: a refused reorder must not rewrite another object's buffer); field count, header icon, badge and the field-inspector aside wait. After a failed load the pillars show the error with no spinner and nothing offered (disclosed). Pins: one per pillar on the #11232 harness, each sequence the card's; the save readings come first (zero during the held load, zero after it), then the control (one save of the item's own document: page `landing` with `LANDING.regions`; flow `nightly_digest` with start `Begin` and status `obsolete`; object `acme_note` with fields `body, field_2`), and what was shown is asserted last. Red-first at the branch point with the card's exact wrong-document writes (dev-measured, per pin). Ablation U/UA separates the halves: with the UI forced on, the hook's refusal alone holds every zero. Right.
- **Member 2, a package switch.** `DataPillar` and `AutomationsPillar` get `key={packageId}` at their mount site (`:1402`, `:1410`), the `InterfacesPillar` shape. The honest fix, not a workaround: the hook cannot see this case (`flow:NAME` and `object:NAME` do not change on a package switch, and the item load is keyed on `current`); the list effect's keep-current is the same-package re-read path (publish, copilot pulse, create) and must keep the open item there; and the state the remount drops is package-scoped (selection, view mode, field selection, the Data load-once ref and namespace, the dirty flag), nothing an author expects to carry across packages. The one cost, an edit under 1.5 s old dropped without a prompt, is the pillar-tab switch's behaviour today and is what #11265 accepted for Interfaces; before this PR that same edit was the wrong-package write. Stated in the changeset. The card's own direction names this shape, and triage's direction cites the Interfaces key as the precedent. Pins: through the real surface and `PackageSwitcher`, B's own item opens and the edit saves it in `com.beta.app` (Data measured for the first time); leg K reads both red. Right.
- **Member 3, the non-editable round trip.** The branch stamps `{}` as that leaf's and clears `ifDirty` (`:2244-2247`), ending the dirty period as it replaces the buffer, as the card's direction asked. Measured first, as triage asked: 1 save of page `home` with body `{}` at the branch point. Pin: zero saves across the round trip with `home`'s reload held, then the control once with `HOME.regions`; leg N 1 red, N1/N2 each green (each half holds alone, disclosed). The hook's comment is corrected to the callers as they now are. Right.
- **The control** is present in all six pins and saves exactly once, to the item's own document. Right.

**(c) The deviations.**
1. **The adapted #11232 pin.** Its two save readings are unchanged; the middle step types only if the rail offers a form and asserts last that it did not. The consequence, measured by the dev (legs C, UC): PR #11265's claim-target comparison no longer has a pin that fails on it alone. Read at source: that comparison gates only the dirty-flag clear in each `doSave` (page `:2305`, Data `:3516`, Automations `:4472`); its effect is observable only while the buffer still equals the sent snapshot, and over that whole window `loadedFor` differs from `target`, so the timer, `flush` and `sending` refuse regardless and the next install clears the flag. The behaviour the old pin held (no save of `home`'s document as `landing`'s) is still pinned; the mechanism is now doubly held (leg UA: with `loadedFor` removed, `since` still holds that pin's saves). A pin that fails on the comparison alone would need two items with byte-identical documents. Acceptable loss; the comparison stays as settled behaviour, as the PR says. Right.
2. **The Data load clears its dirty flag at install.** Inside the rule's caller contract (every install clears the flag, which the corrected hook comment now states truthfully) and the claim's file surface; leg UD shows it load-bearing with the UI half off. Its side effect on a same-object reload (a publish): an edit taken during the reload is dropped with no save, where before the install replaced it and the served document was sent back as a draft. The edit was lost both ways; the pointless write is gone. Disclosed. Right.
3. **The Interfaces nav passes `loadedFor`.** Required by the option's type; set only at the app load's install. In-package the stamp lags `appName` only between `setAppName` and the install (the first load, or a re-read whose app name changed, which then installs), so the nav autosave, #11189's Done-flush and the #11203 pins are unchanged. Right.
4. **`sending` returns `DraftSend | null`**, 5. **`addField` moved below the hook call** (temporal dead zone), 6. **badge, field count and header icon gated on `loaded`**: all inside the claim's one file and inside triage's "nothing is shown under the new item until its own document is in". Right.
7. Commit trailers and the PR footer: outside the diff; noted.

### ② Semver level

One changeset, `.changeset/11272-buffer-bound-to-loaded-item.md`, `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` (the package is at 17.6.0). `patch` is right: no export moves (① above), the hook and its claim type are module-private, no prop, schema, accept set or i18n key changes, and what ships is a behaviour fix in an internal Studio view. The changeset's three bullets match the diff: the load window (editor, switch, add-field, reorder, field count and badge wait), the package switch (both pillars start fresh; an edit under 1.5 s old is dropped), the non-editable leaf (the page's unsent edit is dropped and no empty draft is sent). The pending `6681-declared-lazy-marketplace-routes.md` names this file; its static-import claim about `SuggestedBindingsPanel` still holds, no import line moves in the diff (`Changeset Claim Re-read` reports 1 pending declaration, exit 0). `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Declaration` and `Changeset Fixed Group Check` are success on the head. `Clause-②: no` on the PR and in the claim is right for the same reason: nothing a consumer accepts or imports changes.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none. Deviations 1 to 7: each answered under ①(c).
- **Out-of-scope observation, the Data "last saved" hint.** Confirmed at source: `savedAt` is written only in `doSave` (`:3517`) and rendered in the Data header outside the `objLoaded` gate (`:3666`), so it shows the previous object's time under the next one until that object is saved; the new key resets it on a package switch only. Not in scope of this card's rule: it is not the buffer, there is no write, and it persists after the load completes, so it is not a load-window member. An Acceptance note is the right carrier as filed; the seat's filing gate asks a measured reach and this is read at source. If the seat wants it filed, the pillar already exposes `data-testid="data-saved-at"`, so one reading after an object switch on the #11232 harness meets the gate. Not blocking.
- **Leg A is green** (the hook's `loadedFor` comparison removed, UI kept): the committed pins hold the refusal only through the UI half. Accepted: triage's pin is the sequence's zero-save reading, which holds; the hook half is where the rule lives and is load-bearing for any edit that does not come through the gated UI (a programmatic patch during a load), and the dev measured it alone (U vs UA). Noted for the seat; not blocking.
- **A failed load** keeps the previous item's buffer, shows the error only and refuses every save on it. Read at source, not pinned; inside the rule. Accepted.
- **The dropped edit on a package switch** (Data and Automations, under 1.5 s, no prompt): accepted as #11265 accepted it for Interfaces; before this PR it was the wrong-package write. Stated in the changeset.
- **The server's answer to an empty page body**: not measured; moot, no `{}` is sent now.
- **`main` since the branch point**: 11 commits, none touches the PR's three paths, so no textual overlap.
- **Scope**: 3 files, `Fixes #11272`, no label writes; the PR is a draft for the seat to flip after its ACCEPT.
- **CI on the head**, read at 2026-10-01T00:24:18Z: 43 check-runs, 38 success, 3 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard)` and `dependabot`, the expected skips on this PR), 0 failure. Success includes `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Build & E2E`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Test (shard 2/8)` through `Test (shard 8/8)`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Control Byte Scan`, `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check` and the four changeset gates. **Not concluded: `Test (shard 1/8)` (`in_progress`) and the `Test` roll-up (`queued`).** Not read as pass or fail; the ACCEPT re-reads them. The dev's local readings (type-check exit 0, pin file 14/14, 82 files / 481 tests in `studio-design/`, 21 outside readers / 326 tests) are the dev's, not CI's.
